input.free_text_description: The system operates in the e-commerce, messaging domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, System, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include cart service, cart service impl, comment. Core business data revolves around BaseEntity, DataEntity, ErrorEntity, IdGenerator. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to add items to a shopping cart and check out, so that I can conveniently collect items before purchasing.
As a API Consumer, I want to comment on posts, so that I can participate in discussions and provide feedback.
As a Customer, I want to place and track orders, so that I can purchase items and monitor their delivery status.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
